CustomField.label: Applies When (Formula)
CustomField.description: A Salesforce formula returning true or false, evaluated against the current record. Required when "Applies To" is "When a formula is true". True means the check applies and runs; false means it is Skipped. Leave blank for any other "Applies To" choice. Formula syntax only - not Apex or SOQL.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Required when "Applies To" = "When a formula is true". Salesforce formula returning true/false, e.g. ISPICKVAL(Type, "Partner"). True = run the check; false = Skipped.
